proof_body:
by
  intro f n hf
  have hc : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => f x * Real.cos (n * x)) MeasureTheory.volume (-Real.pi) Real.pi := hf.mul_continuousOn (by fun_prop)
  have hs : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => f x * Real.sin (n * x)) MeasureTheory.volume (-Real.pi) Real.pi := hf.mul_continuousOn (by fun_prop)
  have hc' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => ((f x * Real.cos (n * x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) MeasureTheory.volume (-Real.pi) Real.pi := ⟨hc.1.ofReal, hc.2.ofReal⟩
  have hs' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => ((f x * Real.sin (n * x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) MeasureTheory.volume (-Real.pi) Real.pi := ⟨hs.1.ofReal, hs.2.ofReal⟩
  have e : ∀ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-(n : ℂ) * x * Complex.I) * (f x : ℂ) = ((f x * Real.cos (n * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) - Complex.I * ((f x * Real.sin (n * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro x
    have h1 : -(n : ℂ) * x * Complex.I = ((-(n * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h1, Complex.exp_mul_I]
    push_cast
    rw [Complex.cos_neg, Complex.sin_neg]
    ring
  simp only [e]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hc' (hs'.const_mul _), intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal, intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  push_cast
  field_simp
